mcp_tools.name: native_mobile_build_plan
mcp_tools.title: Native mobile build plan
mcp_tools.description: Submits a native mobile build-plan record (device constraints and platform citizenship, offline-first and sync, builds and signing, testing and accessibility, release/store and privacy, red lines) and returns a deterministic NATIVE_MOBILE_BUILD_PLAN_READY / NATIVE_MOBILE_BUILD_PLAN_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed per-permission feature-coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared build-plan record; it builds no app and submits nothing to any store.

inputSchema.description: The native mobile build plan manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All 46 checks pass. Computed spot checks: permissions_count=1, feature_coverage=1.000000
